build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized physics scene variables
create_catapult: create a catapult structure with a base, hinge ball, dynamic bar, and top ball
add_physics_body: add static or dynamic physics bodies like balls, bars, and standingsticks to the scene
update_task_goal: update the task goal by setting body relationships such as TOUCHING between two objects
set_solution_meta: set the solution tier metadata to TWO_BALLS for the physics puzzle task
